2.0.0.en: Complete rewrite of the vehicle connection layer, now also supporting AU, CN, CA and US regions. Added flow cards for find-my-car, remote windows, charge port, charging current, V2L discharge limit and valet mode. Fixed engine-type detection for some EVs/PHEVs, an odometer crash, the tire-pressure alarm not triggering, a locked-status false negative on sunroof-less cars, and broken distance-changed/is-moving flow cards. Devices now show a clear reason when they become unavailable.

1.3.0.en: Fixed login for new API endpoints.

1.2.2.en: Fixed detection of ccuCCS2 HEV. Added HP2016/2019 warning in readme. Fixed support link.

1.2.0.en: Fixed car parked detection. Updated icons. Added capability migration.

1.0.1.en: Updated icons. Refresh button state fix. Minor improvements.

2.2.0.en: Fix app crash. Fix location fetching for CCS2.

2.3.0.en: Added capabilities and flows for SoH, Flash, Honk, Vent, Chargeport, Valet mode, Break fluid, Washer fluid and Key fob. Improved flows for LimitAC, A/C and Defrost. Fix speed for CCS2. Auto-remove unsupported flows and capabilities. Add all translations.

2.3.1.en: Implement unit aware handling of car data. Improve capability migrations. Cleanup inline comments. Remove HP2016/19 warning.
